findings.description: The user_data script exports AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as plaintext long-lived credentials. User data is retrievable from the instance metadata service (including via SSRF against the public web server) and is stored in cleartext in Terraform state and the EC2 API.
No root_block_device or ebs_block_device encryption is configured, so the instance's root storage is created without an explicit encryption-at-rest guarantee.

No metadata_options block sets http_tokens = "required", so IMDSv1 remains enabled. Given the credentials embedded in user data and the instance's direct internet exposure, an SSRF in the web application yields those credentials trivially.

The instance is launched into a subnet with map_public_ip_on_launch = true that is routed to an internet gateway, so it receives a public IP and is directly reachable from the internet on the wide-open SSH and HTTP ports of its security group.
Ingress on TCP port 22 is permitted from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing administrative SSH access on a publicly addressed host to the entire internet for brute-force and exploitation attempts.

findings.issue_category: unrestricted egress and cleartext HTTP ingress
findings.description: Egress allows all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0, enabling unrestricted data exfiltration and command-and-control from a compromised host; ingress on port 80 from the world serves traffic in cleartext with no TLS listener defined.
The volume does not set encrypted = true (the attribute is explicitly commented out), so data written to the volume attached to the web host is stored unencrypted.
The snapshot is taken from an unencrypted volume and therefore persists an unencrypted copy of the data that can be restored or shared to other accounts.

map_public_ip_on_launch = true combined with the route table association to the internet gateway means every instance in this subnet is automatically internet-addressable, removing the network boundary in front of workloads.
map_public_ip_on_launch = true and association with the internet-gateway-routed table cause every instance launched here to receive a public IP, eliminating network segmentation.
The VPC flow log bucket defines no server-side encryption configuration, so network telemetry revealing internal addressing and traffic patterns is stored without encryption at rest.

findings.issue_category: missing public access block and TLS policy
findings.description: No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, bucket policy denying non-TLS access, or versioning is defined for the flow log bucket, so the log data could be made publicly readable by a later ACL or policy change and can be retrieved over cleartext HTTP.
